name: TickTick
description: TickTick is a to-do list and calendar app that helps users capture ideas, organize tasks, and manage time with multiple planning views, habit tracking, and built-in focus tools, syncing in real time across devices.
best_for: Positioned for individuals who want a to-do list combined with calendar planning, habit tracking, and time-blocking in one free-to-start app.
features: Multiple calendar views: yearly, monthly, weekly, daily, and agenda
Kanban boards, timeline view, and Eisenhower Matrix for prioritization
Built-in Pomodoro timer for focus sessions
Habit tracker with statistics and flexible tracking options
Natural language processing for automatic date and time recognition
Task sharing and assignment for collaboration

alternatives.name: Todoist
alternatives.description: Task management software with natural language date entry and Karma points.
alternatives.best_for: Productivity enthusiasts wanting rapid text input and filters

alternatives.name: Any.do
alternatives.description: Daily planner and to-do app with unified calendar and WhatsApp reminders.
alternatives.best_for: Users wanting daily morning planning routines

alternatives.name: Things
alternatives.description: Minimalist GTD task manager for macOS, iPad, and iPhone.
alternatives.best_for: Apple device users wanting one-time purchase task software

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: 9 lists, 99 tasks per list, 1 attachment/day, 2 reminders per task, and basic calendar/feature limits.

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.notes: 299 lists, 999 tasks per list, expanded reminders/attachments, unlimited calendar views, timeline, filters, themes, statistics, and more.

cons: The Free plan has hard capacity limits such as 9 lists and 99 tasks per list, with reduced calendar, reminder, attachment, and customization capabilities.
Premium is sold as an annual $49.99 subscription on the current official upgrade page; subscription billing auto-renews unless canceled.
